body:
Adds `research/position-rent` (MIT, stdlib-only Python, 8 tests, white paper, experiments) plus README and portfolio page entries.

- Trader rent in a sequential LMSR is the conditional mutual information b·I(y; s_k | s_<k); rents telescope to the maker's expected loss (≤ b ln 2), checked against an explicit cost-function simulation.
- Rents fall with position at roughly the Chernoff rate (numerical); order only redistributes a fixed total.
- Entry costs: subsidy vs number of verifiers and accuracy trade-off.
